head: bḏl (< Arab. bḏl (V) cf. Wehr 75: sich nicht schonen; 322;)

senses.gloss: verwelken (to wither), verfaulen (to get rotten – İlyas does not know this meaning);

stems.sensesRaw: verwelken (to wither), verfaulen (to get rotten – İlyas does not know this meaning);

examples.turoyo: I nuro nafilo bu ṭuro, baḏili aɁ=Ɂilone kulle.
examples.translation: Fire broke out in the mountain, all the trees withered.
examples.raw: I nuro nafilo bu ṭuro, baḏili aɁ=Ɂilone kulle. Fire broke out in the mountain, all the trees withered. (İlyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: Ap pallat daɁ=Ɂilone baḏili mu ḥemo.
examples.translation: The leaves of the tree withered because of heat.
examples.raw: Ap pallat daɁ=Ɂilone baḏili mu ḥemo. The leaves of the tree withered because of heat.(İlyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: Lu ḥuldo axile aw wariḏe du=šrulo, u=šrulo baḏәl.
examples.translation: The mole ate the roots of šrulo, the šrulo withered.
examples.raw: Lu ḥuldo axile aw wariḏe du=šrulo, u=šrulo baḏәl. The mole ate the roots of šrulo, the šrulo withered. (İlyas p.c)

examples.turoyo: Bu qayṭo koboḏal u gelo mu=ḥemo.
examples.translation: In the summer the grass withers because of heat.
examples.raw: Bu qayṭo koboḏal u gelo mu=ḥemo. In the summer the grass withers because of heat. (İlyas p.c)
